scope: Observed convenience cohort, not a production-wide forecast

definitions.dbSeconds: Finished minus started from the matched crawl_runs row; excludes initial platform detection and post-completion inventory reconciliation.
definitions.elapsedSeconds: Observed whole pass wall time, including the full crawlRoaster call.
definitions.estimatedModelUsd: ((input-cachedInput)*0.25 + cachedInput*0.025 + output*2) / 1e6. Published GPT-5 Mini rates, not invoices.
definitions.http: Axios/fetch attempts during each roaster, including observed retries; setup and evidence snapshot reads excluded. HTTP 406 first-pass REST misses are expected lookup misses.
definitions.maxRssKiB: Cumulative process peak, shared process across both passes; not isolated pass memory use.
definitions.coverage: Field presence and observed catalog state, not human-validated accuracy or distinct saleable-product coverage.
definitions.noteTaxonomy: Presence of the note-normalization record, including records with empty canonical categories.
definitions.freshEvidence: Checked at or after measurement start, with a nonempty evidence array; includes unknown observations.
